purpose: Test whether the selective-correction phase is stable to simulator seeds, useful-advantage definitions, and candidate-set size without reading real-domain outcomes.

shared.split: 60% train clusters / 20% calibration clusters / 20% test clusters
shared.calibration: maximize realized counterfactual gain with conservative high-threshold tie breaking
shared.reliable_win: positive mean margin and win probability >= 0.80 against both comparators

advantage_definition_sensitivity.advantage_magnitude: absolute Normal(0.75 + 0.35 * abs(stable signal), 0.35), clipped at 0.05

definitions.rank: top 20% advantage within each training partition

advantage_definition_sensitivity.evaluation_utility: continuous realized advantage, unchanged across definitions

candidate_distribution.shared_case_definition: candidate signs share a case-level random effect while preserving marginal proposal precision
candidate_distribution.action: choose the highest-scored candidate or STOP
candidate_distribution.apply_all_definition: always execute the highest-scored candidate without STOP

interpretation_rule: Robustness is supported only for prespecified cells and summaries. No grid, threshold, candidate count, seed, or success criterion may be changed after execution; any extension is exploratory.
